description: This file defines the QuizzesScreen widget, a stateful Flutter UI component that displays a list of quizzes fetched from a repository. It handles loading state, empty list state, and navigates to the quiz attempt screen when a quiz is selected.

classes.name: QuizzesScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying the list of quizzes.

classes.name: _QuizzesScreenState
classes.description: State object managing quiz list, loading state, and UI rendering.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and triggers loading of quizzes.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches quizzes from repository and updates UI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying loading indicator, empty message, or list of quizzes.
